transcript.en: In this session in your training day we're going to look at some of the more specialised holidays we offer at BC Travel.
transcript.zh: 在培训日的讲座中，我们会关注一些 BC旅游公司提供的定制假期服务。

transcript.en: Now, the travel business is very competitive and it's important to be aware of how the market's changing and developing.
transcript.zh: 时下的旅游业竞争十分激烈，因此知道市场如何变化和发展是很重要的。

transcript.en: In terms of age groups,
transcript.zh: 就年龄层来说，

transcript.en: the over-65s are an important market,
transcript.zh: 65岁以上人群是一个重要市场，

transcript.en: and one that's increasing steadily year on year.
transcript.zh: 这一年龄层的业务每年都稳定增长。

transcript.en: The fewest holidays are taken by the 31 to 42-year-olds,
transcript.zh: 度假最少的人群在31岁至42岁之间，

transcript.en: and that figure shows no sign of rising.
transcript.zh: 而且该年龄层的业务数字没有增长的迹象。

transcript.en: The biggest market at present is still the youngest group,
transcript.zh: 目前最大的市场仍然是最年轻的群体，

transcript.en: the 16 to 30s, but this group's also seen the biggest drop over the last few years.
transcript.zh: 即16岁至30岁的人群，但是这一群体在过去的几年里也经历了最大的跌幅，

transcript.en: whereas there's a noticeable growth in the number of holidays taken by the 55 to 64-year-olds.
transcript.zh: 而55岁至64岁人群的度假时间却显著提升。

transcript.en: As far as the 43 to 54-year-olds are concerned,
transcript.zh: 至于43岁至54岁的人群，

transcript.en: bookings there are steady, but I have to say we haven't seen the increase we expected.
transcript.zh: 预订的数量很稳定，但我不得不说没有出现我们预期的增长。

transcript.en: One trend we're noticing with nearly all age groups is the growing popularity of holidays in which clients do some kind of specialised activity.
transcript.zh: 就几乎所有年龄层而言，我们注意到一个趋势： 客户能在其中参与一些特别活动的假期越来越受欢迎。

transcript.en: I'm not talking here about adventure holidays, where clients take part in high-risk activities like white water rafting just for the thrill of it.
transcript.zh: 我说的不是那种探险之旅，在其中客户仅仅为了刺激参加一些诸如漂流的高风险活动。

transcript.en: Activity holidays usually involve rather less high-risk sports, or things like art and music.
transcript.zh: 特别活动假期通常包括一些较低风险运动，或艺术和音乐之类的东西。

transcript.en: They're not necessarily cheaper than ordinary holidays,
transcript.zh: 这种假期并不一定比普通的假期便宜，事实上，

transcript.en: often the opposite, in fact.
transcript.zh: 通常恰恰相反。

transcript.en: But they do often take place outside the main tourist centres.
transcript.zh: 但这种假期通常不是在主要的旅游中心度过的，

transcript.en: which gives an opportunity for clients to find out more about the local people and customs,
transcript.zh: 这就给了客户体会当地风土民俗的机会，

transcript.en: and many say this is one of the most positive features of these holidays.
transcript.zh: 很多人说这也是这类假期最正面的特点之一。

transcript.en: Of course, they offer the chance to develop a new skill or talent,
transcript.zh: 当然，这类假期也给人们发展新技能、新才能提供了机会，

transcript.en: but clients often say that more than this,
transcript.zh: 但客户常说相较于此，

transcript.en: it's the chance to create lasting relationships with other like-minded people that's the main draw.
transcript.zh: 同其他志趣相投的人建立持久关系的机会才是其主要的吸引力。

transcript.en: Let me give you some examples of BC Travel activity holidays.
transcript.zh: 下面我来介绍几个BC旅游公司特别活动假期的例子。

transcript.en: Our painting holidays take place in four different centres in France and Italy and they're very popular with clients of all abilities from beginners onwards.
transcript.zh: 我们的绘画假期在法国和意大利四个不同的中心开展， 在从初学者往上的所有不同能力的游客中，它都非常受欢迎。

transcript.en: We've got an excellent team of artists to lead the classes - some of them have been with us from the start,
transcript.zh: 我们有一个出色的艺术家团队领导各个班级，他们中有一些人从一开始就与我们合作，

transcript.en: and five additional ones will be joining us this year so that we can offer a greater number of classes in each centre.
transcript.zh: 另外还有5位将会在今年加入我们，这样我们就能在每个中心开更多的班级了。

transcript.en: As far as cooking holidays are concerned,
transcript.zh: 就烹饪假期而言，

transcript.en: I know a lot of agents offer holidays where clients cook recipes related to one particular country,
transcript.zh: 我知道在很多机构提供的假期服务中，客户只是做某个特定国家的菜，

transcript.en: usually the one they're staying in, but we focus on dishes from a great many different ones.
transcript.zh: 通常是他们度假所在的国家，但我们则关注来自更多不同国家的美食。

transcript.en: Apart from that you'll find the usual emphasis on good quality, organic ingredients -that's more or less a given nowadays - and there are generally some meat-free recipes included.
transcript.zh: 除此之外，你会发现我们的重点通常是在优质、有机的原料上， 这或多或少是理所应当的事，此外该假期还包含了无肉食谱。

transcript.en: Our photography holidays take place in a wide range of countries from Iceland to Vietnam,
transcript.zh: 我们的摄影假期在很多不同的国家开展，从冰岛到越南，

transcript.en: and clients have the opportunity to see some stunning scenery.
transcript.zh: 客户有机会看到一些绝美的风景。

transcript.en: Groups are small, no more than eight,
transcript.zh: 假期活动中的小组人都不多，不超过8个人，

transcript.en: so clients can have one-on-one tuition during the holiday,
transcript.zh: 客户可以在假期中得到1对1的指导，

transcript.en: and excursions are arranged with fully-trained guides.
transcript.zh: 短途旅行也会被安排与接受过训练的导游一起。

transcript.en: At the end of each holiday an exhibition is held of the photographs taken so that clients can see one another's work and receive valuable feedback from the tutor.
transcript.zh: 在每个假期结束时，都会举办一个展览，展示所拍摄的照片，以便客户可以看到彼此的作品，并从导师那里得到宝贵的反馈。

transcript.en: Finally, let me tell you about our fitness holidays.
transcript.zh: 最后，我来介绍一下咱们的健身假期。

transcript.en: In Ireland and Italy we run one-week general fitness classes for all ages and levels of fitness.
transcript.zh: 我们在爱尔兰和意大利开设了为期一周的健身课程，该课程适合所有年龄层和体格的人。

transcript.en: Clients start the course with a consultation with a trainer,
transcript.zh: 客户通过咨询教练开始课程，

transcript.en: and together they draw up an individual programme.
transcript.zh: 然后他们一起制定个人健身计划。

transcript.en: As well as improving general fitness,
transcript.zh: 除了改善个人整体的身体状况外，

transcript.en: clients find that they end up losing much of the stress they've built up in their daily lives.
transcript.zh: 客户们发现他们最终还释放了很多日常生活中积累起来的压力。

transcript.en: In Greece, we have a two-week holiday for clients who want to do something about their weight.
transcript.zh: 在希腊，我们有一个为期两周的假期活动，专门服务那些想要改善体重的顾客。

transcript.en: This has all the features you'd expect, like a personalised diet programme,
transcript.zh: 这个假期有你可以预期的各种特点，比如说私人订制的节食计划，

transcript.en: but one of its most popular features is that the exercise classes are all held on the beach.
transcript.zh: 但最受欢迎的特点还是锻炼课程全是在海滩上进行的。

transcript.en: People say it's far preferable to being in a gym.
transcript.zh: 人们说这比在健身房里更让人中意。

transcript.en: Finally, we offer several holidays in Morocco.
transcript.zh: 最后，我们也在摩洛哥开展了好几个假期活动。

transcript.en: One very popular one is the mountain biking holiday.
transcript.zh: 山地自行车假期是其中非常受欢迎的一个。

transcript.en: Bikes are provided and there are different routes according to people's ability.
transcript.zh: 自行车由我们提供，根据客户的能力有不同的骑行路线。

transcript.en: We offer one which is tailored to the needs of families, which is particularly popular.
transcript.zh: 我们有一条针对家庭需要特别定制的路线，尤其受欢迎。

transcript.en: OK, so that's about all the time I have today, so thank you very much…
transcript.zh: 好了，这就是我今天要讲的全部内容，谢谢大家...
